samuel2.8.p1.b1.text: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.

samuel2.8.p1.b2.text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord. …

samuel2.8.p1.b3.text: So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.

samuel2.8.p2.b1.text: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.

samuel2.8.p2.b2.text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.

samuel2.8.p2.b3.text: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute.

samuel2.8.p2.b4.text: So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

samuel2.8.p3.b1.text: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

samuel2.8.p3.b2.text: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.

samuel2.8.p3.b3.text: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,

samuel2.8.p3.b4.text: he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him … Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze,

samuel2.8.p4.b1.text: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued—

samuel2.8.p4.b2.text: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

samuel2.8.p4.b3.text: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David.

samuel2.8.p4.b4.text: So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

samuel2.8.p5.b1.text: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:

samuel2.8.p5.b2.text: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;

samuel2.8.p5.b3.text: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was the scribe;

samuel2.8.p5.b4.text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
